These tools reduce the cost of repeated judgments and standardized steps. Dentists can focus on complex treatment decisions, precision surgery, and patient communication, where AI remains weak.
ai_s2_accel: Digital implant navigation improves surgical precision
AI orthodontic simulations assist tooth-movement planning
3D printing produces implant guides and temporary restorations
Teleconsultation platforms enable collaboration on difficult cases
ai_s2_auto: AI image analysis automatically flags cavities, periapical lesions, and other abnormalities
Intraoral scans automatically generate digital models
Automated design of implant guides and restorations
Electronic case records and image archiving
ai_s3_list: Surgical decisions: weighing options when bone conditions are poor or tooth position is unusual.
Precision technique: tactile control under a microscope and with an ultrasonic bone scalpel.
Patient communication: explaining complex plans clearly and building trust.
Complication management: responding to unexpected postoperative events.
Integrated treatment: planning multidisciplinary care as a whole.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. AI and digital tools are taking over parts of image interpretation, design, and standardized procedures. Specialist dentists retain value through surgical decisions, precision technique, and patient trust, all grounded in years of case experience that AI cannot soon reproduce.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not guarantee security. Specialists who cannot use digital tools will fall behind, while assembly-line dentists with tools but little case depth will also struggle. Use AI as an assistant and make clinical depth the differentiator.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Dentistry combines demanding education with potentially strong returns. Start with undergraduate dental training and develop a specialty. Implant and orthodontic practice require sustained investment, so define a specialty goal early and treat digital imaging and surgical training as core subjects.

Master AI image analysis, digital guides, and intraoral scanning, then build depth in a specialty and difficult cases. Multi-site practice and academic publishing can strengthen professional standing. Do not remain limited to routine cleaning and fillings.

The physician path has strict education and licensing requirements, so a midcareer switch into specialist dentistry is rarely realistic. People with a dentistry background or a firm entry goal can pursue postgraduate dental study and standardized residency training step by step. This is a long-term commitment.

Do not use AI tools to reduce the value of specialist staffing. Use them to reduce image-review and design workloads. Match specialists with surgical teams, digital equipment, and continuing-education budgets to retain clinicians who can handle difficult cases.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatically flags cavities and periapical lesions
Automatically generates models from digital impressions
Provides real-time dynamic guidance for osteotomy preparation
Rapidly forms implant guides and temporary teeth
Three-dimensional reconstruction of tooth roots and nerve canals
Integrated scheduling, medical records, and follow-up

ai_s7_trends: AI image analysis and digital design are becoming common, substantially improving treatment efficiency.
Demand continues to grow in specialties such as implant dentistry and orthodontics, leaving a long-term shortage of specialists.
Teleconsultation and multidisciplinary treatment are becoming standard for difficult cases.

body: Dentists, All Other Specialists are licensed dental physicians who provide specialty care in orthodontics, implant dentistry, periodontics, oral and maxillofacial surgery, and related fields. They diagnose complex oral disease, perform surgery, and coordinate comprehensive treatment.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI image analysis can flag a suspicious periapical shadow in seconds, and implant navigation can achieve 0.1-millimeter precision. The dentist beside the chair still decides whether to proceed and whether the tooth can be saved.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 读片能在几秒里标出可疑的根尖阴影，种植导航能精确到 0.1 毫米，但「这个方案要不要做、这颗牙保不保得住」——最终拍板的，还是坐在诊椅旁边的医生。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年专家牙医在岗约 0.66 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.66 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.02 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 22.58 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代专家牙医，但会深度改变工作方式：AI 读片辅助诊断、数字化导板让种植更精准、口扫和 3D 打印让修复更高效。这些工具把「重复判断」和「标准化操作」的成本打下来，医生的时间转向复杂的方案决策、精细手术和医患沟通——恰恰是 AI 最不擅长的部分。
ai_s2_accel: 数字化种植导航提高手术精度
AI 正畸方案模拟辅助排牙设计
3D 打印种植导板与临时修复体
远程会诊平台辅助疑难病例协作
ai_s2_auto: AI 读片自动标记龋齿、根尖病变等异常
口扫与数字化模型自动生成
种植导板与修复体自动设计
病例记录与影像归档电子化
ai_s3_list: 手术决策：骨条件差、牙位特殊时的取舍判断。
精细操作：显微镜与超声骨刀下的手感。
医患沟通：把复杂方案讲明白、建立信任。
并发症处理：术后意外的临场应对。
综合方案：多学科联合治疗的整体规划。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的「读片、设计、标准化操作」正被 AI 和数字化工具大幅替代，但专科牙医的核心价值在手术决策、精细操作和医患信任上——这些恰恰需要多年病例积累，AI 短期无法复制。中高曝光分数下，专科医生的深度价值反而更凸显。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于高枕无忧：不会用数字化工具的专科医生会落后，但只有工具、没有病例深度的「流水线牙医」同样没竞争力。把 AI 当助理、把深度当壁垒，是专科牙医的正确姿势。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 口腔是医学里「学历要求高、回报也可观」的方向：本科起步、专科深耕，种植正畸等方向尤其需要长期投入。建议尽早明确专科目标，把数字化影像和手术训练当核心课。
把 AI 读片、数字化导板、口扫这些工具学透，往专科深度和疑难病例方向积累。多点执业和学术发表都能抬高身价，别停在常规洗牙补牙的舒适区。
医生路径对学历和资质要求严苛，半路转行做专家牙医不现实；但有口腔背景或想入行的人，可以先从口腔医学考研、规培一步步来，这是长线投入，急不得。
别用 AI 工具去压医生的编制价值，用它减轻读片和设计负担。给专科医生匹配手术团队、数字化设备和进修预算，才能留住真正能扛疑难病例的人。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 自动标记龋齿与根尖病变
数字印模自动生成模型
动态导航实时引导备孔
种植导板与临时牙快速成型
牙根与神经管三维重建
预约、病历与随访一体化

ai_s7_trends: AI 读片与数字化设计普及，诊疗效率大幅提升。
种植、正畸等专科需求持续增长，专科医生长期紧缺。
远程会诊与多学科联合治疗成为疑难病例标配。

body: 专家牙医是口腔医学领域从事专科诊疗的执业医师，专注于正畸、种植、牙周、口腔颌面外科等专科方向，负责复杂口腔疾病的诊断、手术与综合治疗。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 读片能在几秒里标出可疑的根尖阴影，种植导航能精确到 0.1 毫米，但「这个方案要不要做、这颗牙保不保得住」——最终拍板的，还是坐在诊椅旁边的医生。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: CAD can automate marker planning and grading, but patternmakers still use their eyes and hands to judge fit and shape.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 2,800 Fabric And Apparel Patternmakers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 2,500 by 2034, a net decrease of about 300 jobs, with about 300 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $67,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Fabric And Apparel Patternmakers, but it will reduce entry-level roles. CAD and automated cutting speed up routine pattern work, shifting people from hand-drawn patterns toward shape judgment, fit assessment, and sample correction. Repetitive tracing faces replacement, while workers who understand patterns and fit samples remain more secure.
ai_s3_list: Pattern aesthetics: people adjust fit.
Sample correction: people identify problems.
Body-shape judgment: people understand differences.
Design coordination: people interpret intent.
Construction tradeoffs: people balance advantages and limits.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure in a skilled craft. CAD replaces manual steps, while people still control pattern shape and fit.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces repetitive pattern tracing, not pattern aesthetics. People with strong pattern judgment and sample-fitting skills become more valuable as tools raise productivity. Workers who only trace drawings without judgment face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation at a garment vocational school and develop both CAD skill and hands-on judgment. Pure pattern tracing is shrinking in the AI era.
Move from tracing drawings into pattern aesthetics and sample fitting. Learn virtual sample-preview tools.
Highlight pattern-room experience and sample-fitting cases. Factories value consistency and precision.
Do not evaluate candidates only by software skills. Look for pattern judgment and an intuitive sense of fit.

ai_s7_trends: CAD adoption reduces entry-level roles.
Virtual sampling creates opportunities.
Patternmakers who understand fit and samples are in greater demand.

body: Fabric And Apparel Patternmakers create garment patterns from design drawings. They coordinate body measurement, pattern drafting, grading, and marker planning to ensure accurate pieces, proper fit, and efficient material use.
career_ai_description_block.heading: CAD can automate marker planning and grading, but patternmakers still use their eyes and hands to judge fit and shape.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: CAD 能自动排料放码，但版型合身和审美拿捏，还是制版工的眼和手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年织物与服装制版工在岗约 0.28 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.25 万人，岗位净减约 0.03 万个，年均产生约 0.03 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.77 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代制版工，但会压缩基础岗。CAD 与自动裁剪把常规打版提速，人从「手绘纸样」挪向「版型审美、合身判断、试样修正」。真正被替的是纯重复打版，懂版型能试样的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 版型审美：合身靠人调。
试样修正：问题靠人看。
人体判断：差异靠人懂。
设计对接：意图靠人译。
工艺取舍：利弊靠人衡。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的工艺区——CAD 在替动作，但版型与合身还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「纯重复打版」动作，不是「版型审美」的岗位。有版型脑子、能试样的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会照图描版、不动脑的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 服装技校打底，早练 CAD 也练手感，AI 时代纯描版在缩。
从「照图描版」升级成「版型审美 + 试样」，学虚拟预览。
突出版房经验和试样案例，工厂看稳和准。
选人别只看软件，看有没有版型脑子和合身直觉。

ai_s7_trends: CAD 普及，基础岗缩。
虚拟试样带机会。
懂版型能试样更抢手。

body: 织物与服装制版工按设计稿制作服装纸样，统筹量体、打版、放码与排料，保障裁片准确、版型合身与用料合理。
career_ai_description_block.heading: CAD 能自动排料放码，但版型合身和审美拿捏，还是制版工的眼和手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can record spray parameters as curves, but only the hand holding the sandpaper knows how far to correct the color of an old board.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 20,500 Furniture Finishers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 19,800 by 2034, a net loss of about 700 jobs, with roughly 2,000 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $42,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Furniture Finishers. Automated lines can spray standard products, but color matching, old-item restoration, and antique refinishing depend heavily on touch and aesthetic judgment. Most value in this occupation comes from skilled hands. AI can enter recordkeeping and scheduling, but not the core process.
ai_s2_auto: Digital records for spray orders and production logs
Parameter management for automated standard-part spray lines
ai_s3_list: Tactile judgment: touch determines sanding depth and coating thickness.
Color aesthetics: trained eyes make color differences disappear.
Old-item restoration: assess wood and old finishes, then design a custom process.
On-site adaptation: each board differs, so the process changes constantly.
Craft patience: fine work requires resilience and time.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means most work is hands-on. Few desk-based tasks can be standardized by algorithms, mainly peripheral work such as production logs and scheduling.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. Automated spray lines and color software are entering workshops, so finishers who read data and understand equipment will outperform purely manual workers. The greatest pressure falls on people who only spray one standardized product and do not learn restoration.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study woodworking or finishing at a vocational school and apprentice with experienced craftspeople. Color-matching and restoration skills remain scarce in the AI era, so do not fear starting on the workshop floor.
Learn color software and automated lines, then add restoration and antique refinishing skills. Moving from production-line spraying to custom work + restoration creates a clearer premium.
Do not write only that you can spray finishes. Specify colors you matched, old pieces you restored, and results you delivered. A portfolio is an advantage.
Hire for touch and aesthetics, not speed alone. Craftspeople who independently complete custom restoration deserve higher piece rates.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automated alerts for orange peel and particles

ai_s7_trends: Demand for custom furniture and old-item refinishing remains steady, making craft work resilient across cycles.
Automated spray lines are spreading and reducing pure production-line roles.
Versatile craftspeople who match colors and restore furniture command a growing premium.

body: Furniture Finishers treat wooden furniture surfaces through sanding, staining, painting, waxing, polishing, and repairing scratches or dents. They create the desired texture on new furniture and restore the luster of old and antique pieces.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can record spray parameters as curves, but only the hand holding the sandpaper knows how far to correct the color of an old board.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把喷涂参数记成曲线，但一块旧木板的色差该补到什么程度，只有拿砂纸的手知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年家具修整工在岗约 2.05 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.98 万人，岗位净减约 0.07 万个，年均产生约 0.20 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.25 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代家具修整工。喷涂可以上自动线，但调色、旧物修复、古董翻新这些高度依赖手感和审美判断的活，机器短期内做不了。这行八成价值在「手」上，AI 进得来的是记录和排产，进不来的是那道工序本身。
ai_s2_accel: 配色软件辅助调色方案推荐
喷涂缺陷的视觉检测辅助
客户效果的数字化预览
ai_s2_auto: 喷涂订单与生产台账的电子化记录
标准化件自动喷涂线的参数管理
色卡与配方数据库的建立
库存与物料的数字化管理
ai_s3_list: 手感判断：砂到什么程度、漆多厚，靠触觉。
调色审美：把色差补到看不见，靠眼睛。
旧物修复：判断木质旧漆，定制方案。
现场应变：板材不一，工序随时调。
工艺耐心：慢工出细活的抗压。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业大部分时间在动手操作，能被算法标准化的桌面动作很少——主要就是台账和排产这些边角活。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于零变化：自动喷涂线和配色软件已经在进场，未来「会看数据、懂设备」的修整工比纯手工更吃香。真正被挤压的是只做单一流水线喷涂、不学修复的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走职校木工或涂装专业，多跟师傅实习。AI 时代，会调色会修复的手艺人缺口大，别怕起步在车间。
把配色软件和自动线玩熟，补修复和古董翻新技能。从「流水线喷涂」升级成「定制 + 修复」，溢价更明显。
别只写「会喷漆」，写明你调过什么色、修过什么旧件、出过什么效果。有作品集优先。
招人看手感和审美，不止看速度。能独立做定制修复的师傅，值得给更高计件价。

ai_s7_trends: 定制家具与旧物翻新需求稳，手艺方向抗周期。
自动喷涂线普及，纯流水线岗位减少。
会调色会修复的复合手艺人溢价上升。

body: 家具修整工对木制家具进行表面处理，包括砂磨、着色、涂漆、打蜡、抛光以及刮伤凹陷的修复，使新家具呈现所需质感，并让旧家具和古董重新焕发光泽。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把喷涂参数记成曲线，但一块旧木板的色差该补到什么程度，只有拿砂纸的手知道。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can settle transactions automatically, but service workers still explain outcomes, handle anomalies, and enforce compliance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 14,100 Gambling Services Workers jobs in 2024, projected to fall to 13,400 by 2034. That is a net loss of about 700 jobs, with roughly 1,300 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $37,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace these occupations, but it will greatly accelerate settlement and monitoring. Automated systems speed up routine operations, shifting people from reconciliation toward customer explanations, incident response, compliance judgment, and order maintenance. Standard payout-only roles face pressure, while workers who resolve problems and enforce controls become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Customer explanations: communication requires people.
Incident response: calm judgment requires people.
Compliance oversight: people enforce the bottom line.
Maintaining order: respectful service requires people.
Trust-based business: people sustain relationships.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation in a moderate AI exposure range. Systems greatly accelerate settlement and monitoring, while customer service and compliance still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Systems replace standard payout tasks, not compliant service roles. People who handle incidents and enforce controls become scarcer as automation grows.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build attention to detail and compliance knowledge. Standard payout work is shrinking, so develop incident response and control skills early.
Move beyond payouts into compliance, incident response, and customer service. Work toward shift leadership.
Highlight attention to detail and a record free of compliance violations. Gaming venues value steady, accurate workers.
Do not hire only for speed. Evaluate incident response and control judgment, and retain experienced staff who can enforce standards.

ai_s7_trends: Settlement and monitoring systems are spreading, reducing payout-only work.
Compliance controls receive more attention.
Workers who handle incidents are increasingly sought after.

body: Gambling Services Workers handle payouts, settlements, customer explanations, and floor monitoring, helping gaming venues operate safely, orderly, and in compliance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can settle transactions automatically, but service workers still explain outcomes, handle anomalies, and enforce compliance.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 结算能自动，但客户怎么解释、异常怎么处、合规怎么把，还是服务岗的人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年博彩服务从业人员在岗约 1.41 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.34 万人，岗位净减约 0.07 万个，年均产生约 0.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.70 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会大幅加速结算与监测。自动结算与监测把常规操作提速，人从「对账」挪向「客户解释、异常处置、合规判断、秩序维护」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准兑奖的，会处置、能把关的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 客户解释：沟通靠人。
异常处置：冷静靠人。
合规把关：底线靠人。
秩序维护：体面靠人。
信任经营：关系靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光——结算与监测被系统大幅加速，但客户与合规还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准兑奖」动作，不是「合规服务」的岗位。会处置、能把关的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 练细和合规，纯兑奖在缩，早点练处置和把关。
从「兑奖」升级成「合规 + 处置 + 客户」，争取带班。
突出细心与无违规，场子看重稳和细。
选人别只看手脚快，要看会不会处置和把关，能把关的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 结算监测普及，兑奖缩。

Fault-code lookup, repair-manual searches, parts quotes, and work-order entry can all be automated. Diagnosis, disassembly, installation, and adjustment still depend on technicians. Broken machines cannot move themselves into a service bay, and algorithms cannot provide a mechanic's sense of touch.

During the off-season, they can also attract customers by creating maintenance videos.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study mechanical repair at a vocational school and find an internship at a repair shop while learning. Education matters less than hands-on ability in this field. Beginners willing to master electronic fuel injection and lithium-battery systems are in short supply.

Do not limit yourself to carburetors. Learn electronic fuel injection, lithium batteries, and electric equipment diagnostics. Earn a certification, connect a diagnostic tablet, and build your repair cases into a reputation portfolio.

People with automotive or appliance repair experience transition most easily because both fields combine fuel, electricity, and mechanics. In interviews, do not merely claim repair ability; explain what you repaired and how you diagnosed it.

Small engine technicians are consistently hard to recruit. Retain them with off-season income guarantees + peak-season commissions + proper tools. Young technicians willing to learn electronic fuel injection and provide mobile service deserve higher compensation.

Diagnostic tablets and online manuals are becoming standard shop equipment, shifting technicians from memorizing manuals to reading data.
Versatile mechanics who attract customers online, provide mobile service, and understand multiple equipment categories command clear premiums.

body: Outdoor power equipment mechanics diagnose, repair, and maintain small engine equipment such as lawn mowers, chainsaws, leaf blowers, snow blowers, and generators, covering fuel systems, ignition systems, transmission components, and complete equipment adjustment.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can look up fault codes and organize repair checklists, but when a lawn mower will not start and sounds like it cannot catch its breath, only the person crouching beside it can tell whether the problem is fuel delivery or ignition.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你查故障码、排维修清单，但割草机启动不了时那股「憋着喘不上气」的声儿，只有蹲在旁边听的人知道是油路还是点火。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年户外动力设备其他小型发动机机械师在岗约 3.69 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.78 万人，净增约 0.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.35 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.66 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代户外动力设备机械师，但会接管查资料和记工单：故障码查询、维修手册检索、配件报价、工单录入都能自动化。诊断、拆装、调试这些动手活，还得靠师傅。机器坏了不会自己进工位，维修的「手感」更是算法给不了的。
ai_s2_accel: 诊断平板实时读取发动机参数辅助判断
AR/视频指导辅助新手拆装复杂部件
电商配件比价工具缩短采购时间
锂电设备的智能诊断系统普及
ai_s2_auto: 工单录入与客户预约自动化
维修手册与故障码在线检索
配件库存与报价单自动生成
保养提醒与设备台账电子化
ai_s3_list: 听声诊断：从启动音、排气味道判断故障部位。
手工拆装：空间狭小处的拧、撬、敲、磨。
成本判断：判断「修还是换」、报价合不合理。
客户沟通：把技术话翻译成客户听得懂的报价。
灵活应变：老机器没有手册，凭经验摸着修。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行核心是动手和现场判断，能被算法自动化的主要是记录、检索、报价这些桌面活；拆装、试机、判断故障仍靠师傅双手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于不变：诊断平板和在线手册已经在普及，会查数据、会用工具的师傅比只会凭老经验干活的效率高一截，淡季还能靠做保养视频引流开店。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走技校的机械维修类专业，边学边找修理铺实习。这行学历不重要，动手能力才是通行证；愿意钻研电喷和锂电的新人缺口大。
别只会修化油器，学电喷、锂电、电动设备诊断。考个认证，接上诊断平板，把你的维修案例攒成自己的口碑库。
有汽修或家电维修经验的转行最容易，都是「油、电、机械」三件套。面试时别只说会修，举例说清你修过什么、怎么诊断的。
小发动机师傅难招是常态，用「淡季保底 + 旺季提成 + 工具配置」留人。愿意学电喷、接上门服务的年轻师傅值得多给。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 读取发动机参数、辅助定位故障
按型号检索拆装步骤与扭力值
免拆检查缸内积碳与磨损
按标准扭力装配、防滑丝
模拟负载验证修复效果
输入症状获取排查思路

ai_s7_trends: 电喷与锂电设备占比上升，纯化油器维修需求逐年收缩。
诊断平板和在线手册成为门店标配，师傅从「背手册」转向「读数据」。
会做线上引流、能上门服务、懂多品类设备的复合型机械师溢价明显。

body: 户外动力设备机械师负责诊断、维修与保养割草机、链锯、吹叶机、扫雪机、发电机等小型发动机设备，包括燃油系统、点火系统、传动部件与整机调试。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你查故障码、排维修清单，但割草机启动不了时那股「憋着喘不上气」的声儿，只有蹲在旁边听的人知道是油路还是点火。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Digital systems and automation can process prints directly, but experienced craftspeople still determine specialized techniques and color control.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 11,200 photographic process workers and processing machine operators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 10,900 by 2034, a net loss of about 300 jobs, with about 1,500 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $40,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not preserve standard photo-processing roles; it will accelerate their elimination. Digital photography and automated online printing absorb routine demand, shifting workers from high-volume processing toward specialized techniques, fine-art inkjet printing, restoration, and quality control. People limited to standard processing will be displaced, while those who understand technique and color control still have work.
ai_s3_list: Specialized techniques: people provide craftsmanship.
Fine-art inkjet printing: people provide color sensitivity.
Old-photo restoration: people provide experience.
Color-control judgment: people provide the eye.
Equipment troubleshooting: people provide hands-on feel.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 places this occupation in a moderately to highly exposed craft field. Systems accelerate the elimination of standard processing, but specialized techniques and color control still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure means high risk. What gets replaced is standard processing, not roles centered on technique and color control. People with strong craft and color skills remain scarce in art and restoration niches. Those limited to pressing buttons for standard rolls face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting in imaging, chemistry, or art, practice technique and color. Pure processing is shrinking in the AI era, so develop specialized techniques early.
Advance from processing standard rolls to craft techniques + color control, and learn fine-art inkjet printing and restoration.
Emphasize equipment and process experience, and specify materials you have handled. Factories value reliability and precision.
When hiring, assess more than speed; look for process judgment. Core workers capable of specialized techniques deserve higher piece rates.

ai_s7_trends: Digital imaging absorbs standardized roles.
Fine-art inkjet printing and restoration create opportunities.
People who understand process and color control are more sought after.

body: Photographic process workers operate developing and processing equipment, mix chemical solutions, develop, enlarge, and restore photographs, and inspect finished products for color and defects.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Digital systems and automation can process prints directly, but experienced craftspeople still determine specialized techniques and color control.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 数码与自动化能直接冲印，但特殊工艺与色控，还是老师傅定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年操作员工人在岗约 1.12 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.09 万人，岗位净减约 0.03 万个，年均产生约 0.15 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.01 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会保留标准冲印岗，只会加速淘汰。数码摄影与在线自动冲印把常规需求吃掉，处理工从「大量冲印」挪向「特殊工艺、艺术微喷、修复与质控」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准冲印的，懂工艺和色控的人还有活。
ai_s3_list: 特殊工艺：手法靠人。
艺术微喷：色感靠人。
老照片修复：经验靠人。
色控判断：眼力靠人。
设备排故：手感靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的工艺区——标准冲印被系统加速淘汰，但特殊工艺与色控还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光等于高风险：被替代的是「标准冲印」动作，不是「工艺与色控」的岗位。有工艺力、懂色彩的人，在艺术与修复细分里仍稀缺。怕的是只会按按钮冲标准卷的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 影像、化学或美术起步多练工艺和色彩，AI 时代纯冲印在缩，早点练特殊工艺。
从「冲标准卷」升级成「做工艺 + 色控」，学艺术微喷和修复。
突出设备和工艺经验，写清跟过哪些材质。厂里看重稳和细。
选人别只看手快，要看有没有工艺脑子。能做特殊工艺的骨干，值得给高计件。

ai_s7_trends: 数码吃标准岗。
艺术微喷与修复有机会。
懂工艺色控的人更抢手。

body: 影像冲印处理工操作冲印与处理设备，调配化学药液，冲洗、放大与修复照片，检查成品的颜色与瑕疵。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 数码与自动化能直接冲印，但特殊工艺与色控，还是老师傅定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated sorting can speed up work, but postal workers still decide how to answer customers at the counter, coordinate address changes, and safeguard universal service.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 74,200 postal service workers were employed in 2024, projected to fall to 71,600 by 2034, a net decrease of about 2,600 jobs, with about 6,100 openings annually and median annual pay of about $61,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postal service workers, but it will reduce standardized tasks. Automated sorting and tracking accelerate routine mail, shifting postal work from volume processing toward counter service, exception handling, and universal service. Pure sorting roles face the greatest pressure, while people with service skills who can resolve problems are more secure.
ai_s3_list: Counter service: people must answer questions.
Address-change coordination: people manage the relationships.
Universal service: people provide the safety net.
Exception response: people make the tradeoffs.
Service for older adults: people provide the right attitude.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates that this occupation has medium AI exposure: systems accelerate some tasks, but roles remain wherever human judgment and backup support are truly required.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: volume sorting tasks are replaced, not counter and universal service roles. People with strong service and problem-solving skills become scarcer as efficiency improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This career is stable but shrinking. Develop counter-service and system skills early, because pure sorting is declining in the AI era.
Advance from volume processing to service plus problem resolution, and learn systems and compliance.
Emphasize reliability and low complaint rates, qualities valued by postal services.
Do not hire based only on speed. Look for service skills and patience; strong performers deserve counter roles.

ai_s7_trends: Automated sorting spreads, reducing volume-processing work.
Universal service creates opportunities.
People with strong service skills are more secure.

body: Postal service workers lead the acceptance, sorting, and delivery of mail and parcels, coordinate branches, routes, and systems, and use operational and communication skills to ensure timely delivery and serve customers.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated sorting can speed up work, but postal workers still decide how to answer customers at the counter, coordinate address changes, and safeguard universal service.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动分拣能提速，但窗口怎么答、改址怎么协调、普遍服务怎么保，还是邮政人员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年邮政服务人员在岗约 7.42 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.16 万人，岗位净减约 0.26 万个，年均产生约 0.61 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.16 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代邮政服务人员，但会压缩标准环节。自动分拣与追踪把常规件提速，邮政从「跑量」挪向「窗口服务、异常处理、普遍服务」。真正被挤掉的是纯分拣，懂服务、能处置的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 窗口服务：疑问靠人答。
改址协调：关系靠人。
普遍服务：兜底靠人。
异常处置：取舍靠人。
老年服务：态度靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——部分环节被系统加速，但真正要人判断与兜底的地方还留着位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「分拣跑量」动作，不是「窗口服务与普遍服务」的岗位。有服务力、能处置的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这行稳但缩，早点练窗口服务和系统，AI 时代纯分拣在缩。
从「跑量」升级成「服务 + 处置」，学系统与合规。
突出稳和低投诉，邮政看重可靠。
选人别只看快，看服务和耐心，骨干值得给窗口岗。

ai_s7_trends: 自动分拣普及，跑量缩。
普遍服务带来机会。
能服务的人更稳。

body: 邮政服务人员主导邮件与包裹的收寄、分拣与投递，统筹网点、路线与系统，运用操作与沟通手段，保障邮件准时并服务用户。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动分拣能提速，但窗口怎么答、改址怎么协调、普遍服务怎么保，还是邮政人员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: No matter how intelligent monitoring becomes, aides still read face-to-face who is about to lose emotional control and who is struggling silently.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 38,500 psychiatric aides were employed in 2024, falling to a projected 38,300 by 2034, a net decrease of about 200 jobs, with approximately 5,300 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $41,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace psychiatric aides, but it will reduce paperwork. Electronic records and behavioral monitoring take over check-ins and alerts, shifting aides from filling forms toward companionship, observation, activity leadership, and emotional stabilization. Pure administrative recording faces displacement, while people who provide care and respond to emergencies become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Emotional observation: people handle the nuances.
Emergency response: people react in the moment.
Companionship and trust: people build relationships.
Activity leadership: people create interaction.
Safety judgment: people make tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in a moderate AI exposure area. Systems take over paperwork, while face-to-face care remains human-led.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: forms and check-ins are replaced, not companionship and emergency response roles. People who observe carefully and stabilize situations become scarcer as efficiency rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin in nursing or social work and develop patience and observation. Pure recordkeeping is shrinking in the AI era, so build caregiving skills.
Advance from records into observation and emergency response. Learn crisis intervention and aim to lead a team.
Highlight reliability and relevant training, specifying the institutions where you have worked.
Do not select candidates only for compliance; assess observation and de-escalation skills. Key staff who can stabilize a ward deserve allowances.

ai_s7_trends: Rising mental health needs increase jobs.
Monitoring equipment reduces paperwork.
Aides with emergency-response skills are in greater demand.

body: Psychiatric aides care for people with mental illness, assist with daily living, observe medication use, support rehabilitation activities, monitor emotions, and help clinical teams maintain ward safety.
career_ai_description_block.heading: No matter how intelligent monitoring becomes, aides still read face-to-face who is about to lose emotional control and who is struggling silently.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 监测再智能，谁情绪要炸、谁在硬撑，还是靠助理面对面读出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年精神科助理在岗约 3.85 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.83 万人，岗位净减约 0.02 万个，年均产生约 0.53 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.16 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代精神科助理，但会减轻文书。电子记录与行为监测接手打卡和预警，助理从「填表」挪向「陪伴、观察、带活动、稳情绪」。被挤掉的是纯事务记录，会照护能应急的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 情绪观察：细活靠人。
突发处置：反应靠人。
陪伴信任：关系靠人。
活动带领：互动靠人。
安全判断：取舍靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——文书被系统接管，但面对面照护还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「填表和打卡」动作，不是「陪伴与应急」的岗位。会观察能稳场的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 护理/社工方向起步，练耐心和观察，AI 时代纯记录在缩，练照护。
从记录升级成观察与应急，学危机干预，争取带组。
突出稳定性和相关培训，写清待过哪些机构。
选人别只看听话，要看会不会观察和稳场，能顶病区的骨干值得给补贴。

ai_s7_trends: 精神卫生需求升，岗位增。
监测设备减文书。
会应急的助理更抢手。

body: 精神科助理照护精神疾病患者，协助日常起居、用药观察、康复活动与情绪监测，支持临床团队维持病区安全。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 监测再智能，谁情绪要炸、谁在硬撑，还是靠助理面对面读出来。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can explain assistance policies clearly, but only someone who has knocked on the door and sat down to talk knows why an older adult keeps refusing help or what is truly blocking a family.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 449,600 social and human service assistants were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 478,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 28,900 jobs, with approximately 50,600 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $45,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace social and human service assistants. Home visits require trust, case follow-up requires sustained human interaction, and clients' needs often hide in unspoken details. AI can efficiently handle records, documents, and policy searches, but machines cannot make assistance feel personally meaningful.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted needs assessment and risk screening
Online services and remote visits extend reach
AI-assisted policy matching and resource recommendations
ai_s2_auto: Automated generation of documents and reports
ai_s3_list: In-home communication: help clients open up.
Needs assessment: identify real needs from details.
Trust-building: create emotional connections through long-term service.
Resource coordination: bring multiple parties together for implementation.
Emotional support: hold clients' difficult feelings.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places social service assistants where AI clearly improves efficiency but cannot replace the core work. AI takes over records, documents, and searches, while home visits, case follow-up, and trust-building still depend heavily on face-to-face service by front-line personnel.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: A medium score calls for proactive development. Assistants who use digital case systems and AI for policy matching can spend more time with clients and create greater professional value, while roles limited to paper records face faster replacement.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A compassionate student interested in public service can study social work. Families should understand that entry-level pay is modest and intensity is significant, but earning a social-worker credential and advancing toward Project Supervisor can improve income.

Earn a professional social-worker qualification promptly because it is a firm promotion threshold. Master digital case systems, build experience with complex cases, and advance toward project supervision.

People with nursing, early childhood education, or community-work backgrounds transition smoothly. Begin as an assistant to build case experience, then earn a social-work credential and become a professional social worker. In interviews, use concrete examples of clients served and problems resolved.

Front-line assistants have high turnover, and commitment alone does not retain them. Use credential allowances + advancement paths + supervisory support to reduce emotional exhaustion. Digital tools also substantially reduce documentation burdens.

ai_s7_trends: Investment in community governance and public services is increasing, expanding social-work systems.
Digital case systems and AI-assisted tools are entering front-line service.
Credentialing and professional advancement are becoming the industry's dominant direction.

body: Social and Human Service Assistants support professional social workers in case and community services. They conduct home visits, assess needs, connect resources, maintain records, organize activities, and provide basic support to vulnerable groups.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can explain assistance policies clearly, but only someone who has knocked on the door and sat down to talk knows why an older adult keeps refusing help or what is truly blocking a family.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把救助政策解读得清清楚楚，但「这位老人为什么一直不肯接受帮助、这个家庭到底卡在哪」——只有敲过门、坐下聊过的人知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年社会与人类服务助理在岗约 44.96 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 47.85 万人，净增约 2.89 万个岗位，年均产生约 5.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.51 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代社会与人类服务助理：入户探访需要信任，个案跟进需要持续的人际互动，服务对象的需求很多时候藏在不被言说的细节里。AI 能高效处理档案、文书和政策检索，但「把帮扶送到人心里」这件事，机器替不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助需求评估与风险筛查
数字化个案管理系统普及
线上服务与远程探访延伸
AI 辅助政策匹配与资源推荐
ai_s2_auto: 预约与排期管理自动化
ai_s3_list: 入户沟通：让服务对象敞开心扉。
需求判断：从细节里识别真实需求。
信任建立：长期服务的感情连接。
资源协调：在多方之间促成落地。
情绪承接：接住服务对象的负面状态。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明社会服务助理处于「AI 明显提效、但替代不了核心」的位置：档案、文书、检索被 AI 大幅接管，而入户探访、个案跟进和信任建立依然高度依赖一线人员的面对面服务。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中分意味着要主动升级：会用数字化个案系统、能借 AI 做政策匹配的助理，可以把更多时间留给服务对象，专业价值更高；只会做纸质台账的岗位会加速被替代。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 孩子有爱心、想进公共服务体系，可以读社会工作专业。要跟家长讲清楚：这是「用爱发电」的行业起步，薪资不高、强度不小，但考取社工证、往项目主管走能改善收入。
尽快考取社会工作师资格，这是晋升的硬门槛。把数字化个案系统用熟，多积累复杂个案的处理经验，往项目主管、督导方向发展。
有护理、幼教、社区工作背景的转行顺。先做助理积累个案经验，考社工证后转专职社工。面试时重点讲你服务过的对象和实际解决的困难，用案例说话。
一线助理流动性高，靠情怀留不住人。用「持证补贴 + 晋升通道 + 督导支持」留人，减少情绪耗竭——给一线人员配数字化工具，也能显著减轻文书负担。

ai_s7_trends: 基层治理与民生服务投入增加，社工体系持续扩张。
数字化个案系统与 AI 辅助工具进入一线服务。
持证化、专业化晋升成为行业主旋律。

body: 社会与人类服务助理协助专业社会工作者开展个案服务与社区服务，负责入户探访、需求评估、资源对接、档案记录与活动组织，为困难群体提供基础支持。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把救助政策解读得清清楚楚，但「这位老人为什么一直不肯接受帮助、这个家庭到底卡在哪」——只有敲过门、坐下聊过的人知道。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can help monitor X-ray screens, but security screeners still decide whether to open a bag or stop a passenger.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 50,100 transportation security screeners were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 47,100 by 2034, a net loss of about 3,000 jobs, with approximately 4,700 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $63,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace transportation security screeners, but it will change how they monitor screens. AI is taking over initial X-ray image screening, automatic prohibited-item flagging, and passenger queue forecasting, shifting screeners from manually watching screens to reviewing AI flags and handling anomalies. On-site confirmation of suspicious items, communication and conflict resolution with passengers, and responsibility for the final stop-or-clear decision remain irreplaceable. When something goes wrong, people, not algorithms, are held accountable.
ai_s2_accel: Upgraded explosives detection equipment and millimeter-wave scanners
AI-assisted image interpretation with risk-based prompts for bag searches
Pilot programs for checkpoint robots and automated baggage sorting
Centralized review of anomalous images by remote screening centers
ai_s2_auto: Initial X-ray image screening and automatic prohibited-item flagging
Passenger flow forecasting and checkpoint lane scheduling
Digitization, audit trails, and archiving of screening records
Automated identity verification and passenger information matching
ai_s3_list: On-site confirmation of suspicious items: algorithms can flag a possible threat, but people must verify what it is and decide whether to intervene.
Proper bag searches and pat-downs: movements must meet standards and no procedural step can be skipped. Machines cannot replace this process.
Passenger communication and incident handling: explaining rules, calming emotions, and resolving conflicts require tact and patience.
Real-time judgment during emergencies: people follow response plans to decide what to do when equipment alarms, crowds build up, or behavior appears abnormal.
Accountability: every cleared bag carries the screener's approval, and AI cannot bear that responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 rating means that initial screening and process-oriented work is being automated. Systems can now handle preliminary image screening, passenger flow forecasting, and record archiving.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. More accurate initial screening increases the need for screeners who can review findings and handle incidents, making image review and on-site conflict resolution even more important. Low-skill, repetitive screen monitoring is what is being reduced. Screeners who understand equipment, interpret images, and manage checkpoint lanes are more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Vocational school or high school graduates can apply directly to airport positions and earn a transportation security screener occupational skill certificate. For long-term advancement, study civil aviation security screening or security protection and build strong image interpretation skills.

Become proficient with AI-assisted image interpretation systems and new detection equipment. Pursue advanced skill credentials and scanner image interpretation qualifications, then move toward team leader, quality control, or training roles.

Career changers with customer service, security, or military backgrounds often learn quickly. Include concrete metrics on your resume, such as hours spent interpreting images, emergencies handled, and certification levels earned.

When hiring screeners, do not focus only on height and attitude. Assess image interpretation proficiency and emergency response judgment. Younger employees who can use AI screening tools and rapidly review anomalies are worth developing.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic prohibited-item flagging and risk classification

ai_s6_tools.工具: Passenger flow forecasting and scheduling system

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Digitized inspection records and anomaly reporting
Boarding pass and identity document matching, with watchlist alerts

ai_s7_trends: AI image interpretation is becoming standard at security checkpoints. Screeners are moving from constant screen monitoring to reviewing flagged images and handling anomalies, and image interpretation credentials command a clear premium.

As millimeter-wave scanners, trace detectors, and other new equipment become widespread, roles increasingly favor certified skills and emergency response ability, while purely repetitive tasks shrink.

Security requirements will only become stricter, so overall demand should remain stable. However, differences between outsourced and direct-hire roles, as well as certification status, will widen income gaps.

body: Transportation security screeners inspect passengers and carry-on baggage at airports, stations, and other transportation hubs. They operate X-ray machines, walk-through metal detectors, and other equipment to identify and handle prohibited items such as firearms, knives, and explosives.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你看 X 光屏幕，但决定「要不要开包、这个人要不要拦下来」的，还得是安检员。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年运输安全在岗约 5.01 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.71 万人，岗位净减约 0.30 万个，年均产生约 0.47 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.34 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代运输安全安检员，但会改变盯屏方式。X 光图像初筛、违禁品自动标记、客流排队预测这些环节正被 AI 接管，安检员从「纯人工盯屏」转向「复核 AI 标记、处置异常情况」。真正不可替代的是对可疑物的现场确认、与旅客的沟通冲突处置，以及那份「拦不拦」的责任——出了事追责的是人，不是算法。
ai_s2_accel: 爆炸物探测设备与毫米波扫描升级
AI 辅助判图，按风险等级提示开包
安检通道机器人与自动分拣行李试点
远程判图中心集中复核异常影像
ai_s2_auto: X 光图像初筛与违禁品自动标记
客流预测与通道开闸排班
安检记录电子化与留痕归档
证件核验与旅客信息比对自动化
ai_s3_list: 可疑物的现场确认：算法标记了「疑似」，是不是、敢不敢拦，要靠人复核。
开包与手检的规范执行：动作标准、程序不跳步，机器替代不了这道工序。
与旅客的沟通处置：解释规定、安抚情绪、化解冲突，靠的是话术和耐性。
突发事件的临场判断：设备报警、人群拥挤、异常行为，怎么处置按预案由人定。
责任担当：每一件放行的行李背后是安检员的签名，这份责任 AI 扛不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的初筛与流程类工作正被自动化——影像初筛、客流预测、记录归档都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为初筛更精准，安检员被要求「更会复核、更会处置」，判图复核和现场冲突处置反而更重要。真正被挤压的是低技能重复盯屏，懂设备、会判图、能管通道的复合型安检员更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职校或高中毕业可直接走机场招聘，考安检员职业技能等级证书。想走得远，学民航安检、安全保卫相关专业，把判图能力练出来。
把 AI 判图辅助系统和新型探测设备用熟，主动考高级技能等级和开机判图资质，向班组长、质控或培训方向走。
有服务、安保或退伍背景的转行者上手快。简历上多写「判图多少小时、处置过哪些突发、考取哪级证书」这类硬指标。
招安检员别只看身高和态度，要看判图熟练度和应急处置思路。会用 AI 初筛工具、能快速复核异常的年轻员工更值得培养。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 违禁品自动标记、风险分级
检查记录电子化、异常上报
登机牌与证件比对、黑名单提示

ai_s7_trends: AI 判图成为安检标配，安检员从「纯盯屏」转向「复核标记、处置异常」，判图资质溢价明显。
毫米波、痕量探测等新设备普及，岗位向技能等级与应急处置能力集中，纯重复环节收缩。
安保要求只会更严，岗位需求总体稳定，但外包与直签、是否持证的分化会拉大收入差距。

body: 运输安全安检员负责在机场、车站等交通枢纽对旅客及随身行李进行安全检查，操作 X 光机、金属探测门等设备，识别并处置枪支、刀具、爆炸物等违禁品。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can assist with ultrasound interpretation and automatically screen for prostate cancer risk, but physicians still provide the tactile judgment of an endoscopic incision and the trust needed to discuss deeply private concerns with patients.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 340,700 urologists were employed in 2024, with employment projected to rise to 349,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 8,600 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 9,600 openings annually, and median annual pay was ≥$239,200 in 2024 (highest BLS OES category, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace urologists, but it will change the clinical rhythm. AI is assisting image interpretation, PSA risk assessment, and preliminary pathology screening, freeing physicians from repetitive reviews so they can focus on surgery, comprehensive treatment decisions, and patient communication. Surgical technique, final judgment, and physician-patient trust remain human responsibilities. Surgeons who use AI tools diagnose more efficiently.
ai_s2_accel: Automatic identification and classification of urinary stones
ai_s2_auto: Automatic preliminary screening of imaging reports
Automatic interpretation of PSA and other test results
Structured medical records and follow-up notes
ai_s3_list: Tactile surgical skill: a millimeter changes endoscopic dissection and suturing.
Comprehensive treatment decisions: experience balances surgery, medication, and radiotherapy sequencing.
Physician-patient communication and trust: patients need a setting where private concerns can be expressed and understood.
Assessment and management of postoperative complications: people must respond immediately to bleeding and infection.
Continual learning of advanced technologies: people keep pace with robotic surgery and new drugs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means AI is entering about half of the supportive judgment tasks. Imaging, laboratory tests, and preliminary pathology screening are AI strengths, but people still control the main diagnostic and treatment pathway through surgery, treatment planning, and communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI increases diagnostic throughput, while the final mile of surgery and decision-making remains human. Pure image reading and preliminary screening are the areas under pressure, while urologists with strong operating skills who collaborate with AI become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Surgery requires long-term investment, and aging populations support stable demand for urologic surgery. Before choosing it, understand whether you can accept the duration of residency training and the intensity of surgical practice. Build strong anatomy knowledge and fundamental surgical skills in school.

Learn endoscopic and robotic surgery early and become proficient with AI-assisted diagnostic tools. Specialize in areas such as urologic oncology, andrology, or minimally invasive stone treatment, avoiding roles limited to preliminary screening.

People without medical backgrounds generally cannot transition directly into surgery. Alternatives include urologic nursing or technician roles or medical devices such as endoscopes and surgical robots. Highlight operating-room support and device experience on your resume.

When hiring urologists, assess surgical volume and complication rates as well as robotic surgery experience and openness to AI tools. A well-equipped AI-assisted diagnostic system can reduce image-reading workload.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic preliminary screening of ultrasound and CT

ai_s7_trends: Robotic surgery and intraoperative navigation are spreading, making operations more precise and increasing demand for urologists skilled in robotic systems.
AI-assisted early screening is entering routine care, allowing diseases such as prostate cancer to be found earlier and classified more accurately.
Comprehensive cancer treatment and longitudinal management are becoming standard, shifting physicians from procedural surgeons toward full-course care managers.

body: Urologists diagnose and treat diseases of the urinary and male reproductive systems, including kidney stones, urinary tract infections, urologic cancers, prostate disease, and male infertility, combining medication, endoscopic surgery, and postoperative management.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can assist with ultrasound interpretation and automatically screen for prostate cancer risk, but physicians still provide the tactile judgment of an endoscopic incision and the trust needed to discuss deeply private concerns with patients.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能辅助读 B 超、自动筛前列腺癌风险，但腔镜下切开那一下的手感、跟患者聊透「难言之隐」的信任，还得医生来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年泌尿科医师在岗约 34.07 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 34.93 万人，净增约 0.86 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.96 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代泌尿科医师，但会改变临床节奏。影像判读、PSA 风险评估、病理初筛正被 AI 辅助，医生从重复读片里省出时间，投入手术、综合治疗决策和患者沟通。手术操作、终审判断和医患信任，依然在人手上。会用 AI 工具的外科医生，诊断效率更高。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助前列腺癌风险分层
泌尿系结石自动识别分型
ai_s2_auto: PSA 等检验结果自动解读
病理切片 AI 辅助筛查
病历与随访记录结构化
ai_s3_list: 手术操作的手感：腔镜下分离、缝合，差一毫米都不同。
综合治疗决策：手术、药物、放疗怎么排，靠经验权衡。
医患沟通与信任：难言之隐要讲得开、听得进。
术后并发症的判断处置：出血、感染，当场处理靠人。
前沿技术的学习迭代：机器人手术、新药，靠人跟进。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半「辅助判断」任务正被 AI 介入——影像、检验、病理初筛都是 AI 的强项，但诊疗主链路（手术、方案、沟通）仍是人的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 提升的是诊断吞吐量，手术与决策的「最后一公里」始终在人。真正被压缩的是纯读片、纯初筛的辅助环节，主刀能力强、会跟 AI 协作的泌尿科医师更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 外科是长线投入，泌尿外科在老龄化下需求稳。想清楚能接受规培周期和手术训练强度再选，在校把解剖和外科基本功打牢。
尽早掌握腔镜与机器人手术，把 AI 辅助诊断工具用熟。往肿瘤泌尿、男科、结石微创等亚专科深耕，避开纯初筛环节。
非医背景转外科医生基本不可能，可从泌尿外科护士、技师岗位切入，或转医疗器械（腔内镜、机器人）方向。简历突出手术室配合与器械经验。
招泌尿科医师看手术量和并发症率，更要看机器人手术经验和 AI 工具接受度。给团队配好 AI 辅助诊断系统，能缓解阅片压力。

ai_s7_trends: 机器人手术与术中导航普及，手术更精准，会机器人操作的泌尿科医师更抢手。
AI 辅助早筛进入常规诊疗，前列腺癌等疾病「查得更早、定得更准」。
肿瘤综合治疗与全程管理成为主流，医生从「开刀匠」转向「治疗管家」。

body: 泌尿科医师诊断与治疗泌尿系统及男性生殖系统疾病，包括肾结石、尿路感染、泌尿系统肿瘤、前列腺疾病和男性不育，兼顾药物治疗、腔镜手术与术后管理。
